title: Housing Stability Notification Act notice requirement
requirement: A landlord planning to end a tenancy must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources at the same time as the Notice to quit or Notice of non-renewal, and must submit a Notice to Quit / Non-renewal of Lease Submission Verification Form to the City.
coverage_conditions: All landlords ending a tenancy; foreclosing owners must also submit the verification form.

applicability.per_tenancy: Applies when a landlord plans to end a tenancy by notice to quit or notice of non-renewal of lease.

penalty: First offense: warning. Second and subsequent offenses: $300 per day. Violation does not halt the eviction process.
quoted_span: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires any landlord to provide renters with a Notice of Tenant’s Rights and Resources when planning to end a tenancy agreement.
